description: A carved wizard statue on a plinth from the Little Structures datapack, partly wrapped in vines and moss. It reads as a landmark/waypoint piece in a weathered-stone idiom close to the admitted hero-ruin set.

style_fit.rationale: Right idiom and usable as a minor waypoint, but the overgrowth obscures the statue's silhouette in renders, so it lands as a weak hero piece rather than a wow-moment. Keep as a borderline fallback if a landmark slot goes unfilled; prefer hero-standing-monolith first.
